exceptions.exact_allowance: Only the structural write identities, engine methods, size ceilings, specificity literals, Oracle-ID literals, effect operations, and legacy helpers serialized in the fingerprinted baseline.
exceptions.rationale: The centralized engine and compatibility paths predate the default-deny ratchet and must be migrated incrementally without a replay-breaking rewrite.
exceptions.maximum_scope: Existing identities and recorded logical-line ceilings only; removals are allowed and additions or growth are forbidden.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove the exception when every serialized grandfathered allowance has been migrated to a reviewed owner or deleted.
exceptions.replay_implications: No replay behavior change is authorized; each migration must preserve exact command replay and state hashes where behavior is unchanged.
exceptions.privacy_implications: No hidden-information expansion is authorized; principal-scoped projections remain mandatory.
exceptions.security_implications: No capability, arbiter, transport, or state-mutation authority is added by this exception.
